'''''Void Bastards''''' is a [[Science fiction film|science-fiction]] [[first-person shooter]] and [[roguelike]] [[video game]] developed by Blue Manchu and published by [[Humble Bundle]]. It was released on May 28, 2019, for [[Microsoft Windows]] and [[Xbox One]]. Ports of the game for [[Nintendo Switch]] and [[PlayStation 4]] were released on May 7, 2020.<ref>{{Cite web |last=O'Connor |first=James |date=April 16, 2020 |title=Void Bastards Has A Release Date On Switch And PS4 |url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/void-bastards-has-a-release-date-on-switch-and-ps4/1100-6476180/ |access-date=April 23, 2020 |website=[[GameSpot]] |archive-date=20 April 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200420143113/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/void-bastards-has-a-release-date-on-switch-and-ps4/1100-6476180/ |url-status=live }}</ref> The game revolves around surviving in the dangerous Sargasso Nebula by boarding and salvaging materials from spaceships.<ref name="Softpedia">{{Cite web |last=Vasile |first=Cosmin |date=2019-06-23 |title=Void Bastards Review (PC) |url=https://www.softpedia.com/reviews/games/pc/void-bastards-review-526494.shtml |access-date=2020-02-19 |website=[[Softpedia]] |archive-date=9 December 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191209023523/https://www.softpedia.com/reviews/games/pc/void-bastards-review-526494.shtml |url-status=live }}</ref> It received generally positive reviews from critics, who praised its comic-book art style, [[Black comedy|dark humor]], and gameplay, but criticized its lackluster story and replay value.

== Plot ==
The main character is one of many rehydrated prisoners aboard a stranded personnel vessel, whose AI must rely on its dangerous cargo to obtain fuel for a final jump to its destination.<ref name="GameSpot">{{Cite web |last=Barbosa |first=Alessandro |date=2019-05-31 |title=Void Bastards Review - Genres Collide |url=https://www.gamespot.com/reviews/void-bastards-review-genres-collide/1900-6417153/ |access-date=2020-02-19 |website=[[GameSpot]] |archive-date=23 April 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200423011031/https://www.gamespot.com/reviews/void-bastards-review-genres-collide/1900-6417153/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Gameplay ==
The game revolves around a procedurally generated structure, in which the player enters other ships, fights enemies and salvages materials to repair their own ship. If the player dies, they are replaced by another "rehydrated" prisoner,<ref name="Softpedia" /> losing all ammunition, fuel, and food, but keeping weapon and gadget upgrades as well as objective progress.<ref name="GameSpot" /> The game has been described as an [[immersive sim]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Scaife |first1=Steven |title=Void Bastards Review: A Droll Marriage of the Roguelike and Immersive Sim |url=https://www.slantmagazine.com/games/void-bastards-review/ |website=[[Slant Magazine]] |access-date=15 May 2023 |date=29 May 2019 |archive-date=15 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230515234534/https://www.slantmagazine.com/games/void-bastards-review/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Hanson |first=Ben |date=27 March 2019 |title=How Embracing Absurdity Liberated Void Bastards |url=https://www.gameinformer.com/gdc-2019/2019/03/27/how-embracing-absurdity-liberated-void-bastards |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190327204837/https://www.gameinformer.com/gdc-2019/2019/03/27/how-embracing-absurdity-liberated-void-bastards |url-status=live |archive-date=27 March 2019 |access-date=15 May 2023 |magazine=[[Game Informer]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Riendeau |first=Danielle |date=31 May 2019 |title='Void Bastards' Is a Gorgeous Sandbox of Death and Chaos |url=https://www.vice.com/en/article/void-bastards-bioshock-shooter/ |access-date=15 May 2023 |website=[[Vice (magazine)|Vice]] |archive-date=15 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230515234534/https://www.vice.com/en/article/pajq58/void-bastards-bioshock-shooter |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Development ==
Developed by Australian studio Blue Manchu, the game was inspired by ''[[System Shock 2]]'' and ''[[BioShock]]''.<ref name="PCGamer">{{Cite web |last=Roberts |first=Samuel |date=2019-05-28 |title=Void Bastards review |url=https://www.pcgamer.com/void-bastards-review/ |access-date=2020-02-19 |website=[[PC Gamer]] |archive-date=4 October 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241004001525/https://www.pcgamer.com/void-bastards-review/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

=== Legacy ===
A spiritual sequel, ''[[Wild Bastards]]'', was released in September 2024 for [[PlayStation 5]], [[Steam (service)|Steam]], and [[Xbox Series X and S]]. It received generally positive reviews from critics.<ref>{{cite web |title=Wild Bastards review: "A forgettable experience with conflicting design choices that compromise an otherwise intriguing premise" |url=https://www.gamesradar.com/games/fps/wild-bastards-review/ |website=Games Radar |access-date=23 September 2024 |archive-date=23 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240923163843/https://www.gamesradar.com/games/fps/wild-bastards-review/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

''Void Bastards'' received "generally favorable reviews" according to [[Metacritic]].<ref name="MC_PC" /><ref name="MC_XONE" /><ref name="MC_NS" /> Cosmin Vasile of ''[[Softpedia]]'' rated the game 8.5/10, calling it an "absolute delight" due to its comic-book aesthetics and "solid", "addictive" gameplay, but also noting it was "repetitive" with a "weak story".<ref name="Softpedia" /> Alessandro Barbossa of ''[[GameSpot]]'' rated the game 8/10, also praising the art style and "ridiculously designed" but "satisfying" weapons.<ref name="GameSpot" /> Samuel Roberts of ''[[PC Gamer]]'' rated it 71/100, calling the game "slightly messy" but praising its "gorgeous" art style and "excellent" weapons.<ref name="PCGamer" />

=== Accolades ===
The game was nominated for "Xbox Game of the Year" at the [[2019 Golden Joystick Awards]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gamesradar.com/goldenjoystickawards/#xbox-game-of-the-year|title=Golden Joystick Awards 2019|website=[[GamesRadar+]]|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20190928103127/https://www.gamesradar.com/goldenjoystickawards/#xbox-game-of-the-year|archivedate=2019-09-28|url-status=dead|accessdate=2020-02-29}}</ref> and for "Excellence in Visual Art" at the [[Independent Games Festival]] Awards.<ref>{{cite press release|url=https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2020/01/07/1967446/0/en/Mutazione-Eliza-Untitled-Goose-Game-Are-Some-of-the-Key-Nominees-for-the-22nd-Annual-Independent-Games-Festival.html|title=Mutazione, Eliza, Untitled Goose Game Are Some of the Key Nominees for the 22nd Annual Independent Games Festival|date=2020-01-07|website=[[GlobeNewswire]]|accessdate=2020-02-29|archive-date=8 January 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200108144820/https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2020/01/07/1967446/0/en/Mutazione-Eliza-Untitled-Goose-Game-Are-Some-of-the-Key-Nominees-for-the-22nd-Annual-Independent-Games-Festival.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
